sections.subhead: Analytics & Performance Tracking So Every Channel Is Measured

body.html: Teknoppy provides marketing analytics services in Kochi for businesses that spend on SEO, ads and social but cannot see which channel brings enquiries. We set up GA4, Search Console and call tracking so every channel is measured and every report tells the truth.

Getting tracking right matters because most tracking setups are incomplete — page views are counted, but form submissions, phone calls and WhatsApp clicks are not. Without those, marketing decisions are made on traffic rather than on leads.

sections.trustline: 120+ Projects Delivered · In Kochi Since 2018 · GA4, Search Console & Call Tracking

sections.h2: What Our Marketing Analytics Services Include

items.title: GA4 Setup & Configuration
items.html: GA4 setup services in Kochi covering property configuration, event and conversion setup, internal-traffic filtering and Google Tag Manager, so the data you collect is clean from day one.

items.title: Search Console Setup & Reporting
items.html: Google Search Console configuration and GA4 integration connected to reporting that shows which searches and pages actually bring organic visitors to your site. For indexing and crawl fixes, see our Technical SEO service.

items.title: Conversion & Call Tracking
items.html: Conversion tracking setup for enquiry forms, click-to-call, WhatsApp clicks, Meta Pixel / Conversions API, and Google Ads, so every lead can be traced back to the channel and campaign that produced it.

items.title: Looker Studio Dashboards & Reviews
items.html: Marketing dashboards that bring every channel into one view, with regular reviews that explain what was done, what it cost, and what it returned.

items.title: Tracking Audit
items.text: We review what is currently installed — analytics, tags, pixels and conversion goals — and list what is missing, duplicated or misconfigured.

items.title: Measurement Plan
items.text: Together we agree which actions count as a lead or sale for your business, and which channels and campaigns need to be measured against them.

items.title: Implementation
items.text: GA4, Tag Manager, Search Console, conversion events and call tracking are configured and connected to your ad accounts.

items.title: Testing & Validation
items.text: Every form, phone link and conversion event is tested end to end, so the numbers in the reports match what actually happened on the site.

items.title: Reporting & Optimisation
items.text: Dashboards and regular reviews turn the data into decisions — where to spend more, what to fix, and what to stop.

sections.h2: Why Choose Teknoppy for Marketing Analytics in Kochi

items.html: We track leads, not just traffic. Forms, calls and WhatsApp clicks are measured, because those are the actions a Kerala business actually gets enquiries through.
One team for the website, the campaigns and the tracking, so nothing is lost between a developer, an ad agency and an analytics consultant.
Transparent, ROI-focused reporting. You always know what was done, what it cost, and what it returned.
Setups you own. Analytics, Tag Manager and Search Console are configured in accounts that belong to your business, not ours.

sections.intro: This service fits businesses that are:

items.text: Spending on SEO, Google Ads or social media without knowing which channel produces their enquiries
Running Google + Meta ads with conflicting conversion numbers across platforms
Moved from old Google Analytics to GA4 and lost critical event tracking or goal visibility

outro.html: Tracking is most valuable alongside the channels it measures — see Google Ads Management, SEO Services or the full Digital Marketing pillar.
If the data shows visitors arriving but not enquiring, Landing Pages & CRO is usually the next step.

paragraphs.html: Analytics and tracking setup is priced either as a one-time configuration project (typically Rs. 15,000 to Rs. 35,000) or as part of a monthly marketing retainer with ongoing dashboard reporting and reviews. Request a free tracking audit or quote.

sections.h2: Other digital marketing services in Kochi
Frequently Asked Questions — Marketing Analytics in Kochi

items.q: What is included in a marketing analytics setup?
items.a: GA4 and Google Tag Manager configuration, Search Console setup, conversion tracking for forms, calls and WhatsApp clicks, connection to your ad accounts, and a dashboard that reports on all of it.

items.q: We already have Google Analytics. Do we still need this?
items.a: Often, yes. Most existing setups count page views but not enquiries. A tracking audit shows what is missing, duplicated or misconfigured before anything is changed.

items.q: Can you track phone calls and WhatsApp enquiries?
items.a: Yes. Click-to-call and WhatsApp clicks are tracked as conversion events, and call tracking can be added where you need to know which campaign a call came from.

items.q: Who owns the analytics accounts and data?
items.a: You do. GA4, Tag Manager and Search Console are set up in accounts that belong to your business, with access shared to our team. Access is granted to Teknoppy as an authorized user and can be removed at any time; no customer data is exported or stored outside your own accounts.

items.q: How often will we receive reports?
items.a: Dashboards are available at any time, and reviews are held on the schedule agreed in your plan — monthly is typical for ongoing marketing retainers.

items.q: Do you offer analytics on its own, without other marketing services?
items.a: Yes. It can be delivered as a one-time setup and audit project, or as part of an ongoing SEO, Google Ads or digital marketing engagement.

sections.h2: Ready to Measure What Your Marketing Returns?

paragraphs.html: Send us your website and ad accounts. We will audit your current tracking for free and tell you exactly which leads you are missing.
